title: Measurements of the Condylar Surface Area of TMJ in 3D
author: Anna Walczak

steps.title: Import 3D Model
steps.instruction: Import the textured 3D model (.ply file) into MeshLab.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to File → Import Mesh... and select the .ply file, or drag and drop the model into the interface.

steps.title: Apply Curvature Filter
steps.instruction: Activate the color-mapping filter to visualize discrete curvatures.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters → Color Creation and Processing → Discrete Curvatures.

steps.title: Mark Articular Surface
steps.instruction: Identify and mark the articular surface using the Z-Painting function, following the most distinct line of blue dots along the boundary.

substeps.instruction: Zoom in and activate Z-Painting → Red Brush (Vertices Selection).
Select vertices by holding the left mouse button and dragging (selected vertices turn red).
Deselect vertices by holding the right mouse button and dragging.
To change the view, press Esc to exit painting mode, rotate/move the model, and press Esc again to return to selection mode.

steps.title: Select Surface Vertices
steps.instruction: Convert the painted area into a vertex selection.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters → Selection → Select Vertices from Faces.
Inspect the selection (highlighted in red) to ensure it fully covers the articular surface.

steps.title: Isolate Articular Surface
steps.instruction: Remove all mandibular structures except for the selected articular surface.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters → Selection → Invert Selection.
Click Delete Selected Faces and Vertices.

steps.title: Remove Floating Vertices
steps.instruction: Clean the model of any remaining disconnected single vertices to ensure measurement accuracy.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters → Selection → Select Small Disconnected Components.
Click Delete Selected Faces and Vertices.
If unwanted vertices remain, manually remove them by repeating the Z-Painting and Select Vertices from Faces process (without inverting the selection).

steps.title: Compute Surface Area
steps.instruction: Calculate the geometric surface area of the remaining articular region.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Filters → Quality Measure and Computations → Compute Geometric Measures.
Locate the measured surface area value (in mm²) in the lower-right panel of the MeshLab window.
Copy and record the value in a spreadsheet (e.g., Excel).

steps.title: Export Measured Surface
steps.instruction: Optional: Save the isolated surface for later comparison or observer verification.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to File → Export Mesh As… and save the file in the preferred format.
